MO-IT115 Object-Oriented System Analysis & Design

Project Use Case Diagram



Milestone 2 Team Leader

Iannah Estrada

Members:

Jhon Kharl Victoriano

Patrick Paul Dela Cruz

Jeremy Louis Hara

Gerard Maduro

Program and Year Level:

BSIT - 3RD Year





Project Context

<Briefly describe the proposed system and its purpose. Use the information from your approved Project Proposal and Milestone 1: High-Level Project Structural Analysis.



Guide Questions:

What problem does the system address?

Who are the intended users and stakeholders?

What are the major functions of the system?

How does the Use Case Diagram help represent the system's behavior?>



Actor Identification

<Identify and describe the actors that interact with the system.

Actor

Description

Relationship to the System









Guide Questions:

Who interacts with the system?

What role does each actor play?

Which activities or functions are performed by each actor?



Use Case Identification

<Identify the major use cases represented in the system.

Use Case 

Primary Actor

Purpose









Guide Questions

What functionality does the system provide?

Which actor initiates each use case?

How does each use case support the project's objectives?







































Use Case Diagram



	

	Lucid Art Use Case Diagram





Use Case Diagram Analysis

<Analyze the interactions and functionality represented in the diagram.

Guide Questions:

What major interactions are represented in the diagram?

How do the actors interact with the system?

How does the diagram reflect the project's scope and objectives?

Which use cases are critical to the operation of the system?

Were any included or extended relationships used? Explain why.>



Use Case Narrative

<Create a detailed narrative for each major use case identified in the diagram. Replicate the following section for every use case included in your project.>



Identification: <Insert Use Case Code No. 1 - Use Case Name No. 1>

<Provide a brief summary of the use case and its purpose within the system.

Use Case ID

Assign a unique identifier (e.g., UC-01, UC-02).

Use Case Name

Use an action-oriented name (e.g., Register Account, Submit Request).

Business Goal

What user objective or business need does this use case accomplish?



Use Case Definition

Actor

Name the actor/s that will be performing this use case.>

Description

<Provide a high-level explanation of the sequence of steps and the outcome of executing the use case.>

Postconditions

<List the actions that must occur or requirements that must be met before the use case begins. Number each precondition. For example:

User identity has been authenticated.

User computer has sufficient free memory available to launch the task.>

Postconditions

<Describe the system's condition at the end of the use case execution. For example:

Report contains only valid email addresses.

Price of the item in the report has been updated with the new value.>

Expected Outcome

<Specify the expected outcome of the user's activity and the system's reaction. This result should correspond to the user's objective as indicated in the use case.>

Exceptions

<Describe any expected error scenarios during use case execution and how the system will respond to those events. Also, indicate how the system will react if the use case execution fails for an unexpected reason.>

Includes

<List any additional use cases that are part of the use case. Common functionality that appears in several use cases can be separated into a distinct use case that is included by those who require it.>

<Describe the typical sequence of interactions between the actor and the system.>

System Response

<Set the unique identifier for the step within the use case narrative (i.e., Step 1>

<Describe the actor's activities. It might be a button click, data entry, selection, navigation, or any other action initiated by the user.>

<Describe how the system responds to user input. It might include presenting data, conducting computations, providing outputs, or initiating other system processes.>

Step

Actor Action

System Response

<Set the unique identifier for the step.>

<Describe the alternative action performed by the actor.>

<Describe how the system responds to the user input.>
